_comment: Catalog of physical fastening hardware types found in the handbook (Annex 14, §3). Each entry is an 'AttachmentType' — the simulator's Securing module picks from these, never invents new hardware.

attachmentTypes.name: Steel wire lashing (sim çekme)
attachmentTypes.notes: Strand count per lashing is looked up from Table 7 by the angle the lashing makes with both the flatcar's longitudinal axis and its floor. Reused/rewound lashing wire may not be reused a second time (para. 19).

attachmentTypes.name: Wood stop-block / chock (direg dörtgyraň agaç bölegi)
attachmentTypes.material: Sound dry hardwood or softwood timber; aspen/alder/linden prohibited
attachmentTypes.notes: Dimensions selected from Table 2 (by wheel diameter, wheeled vehicles) or Table 3 (by combat weight, tracked vehicles). Long edge placed across the flatcar, against the wheel/track.

attachmentTypes.name: Wood packing board / spacer board / support wedge
attachmentTypes.notes: Distributes load to prevent equipment damage. Cross-boards run the width of the flatcar; spacer boards run the width of the cargo (may overhang cargo edge by up to 200mm within loading gauge). Support wedges minimum 50mm thick.

attachmentTypes.name: Fastening nail (çüý)
attachmentTypes.notes: Length must exceed the wood fastener's height by 50-60mm and fully penetrate the deck planking. Driven >=90mm from the block/deck edge, 30mm from the block's side edge.

attachmentTypes.name: U-shaped iron staple (skoba)
attachmentTypes.notes: Joins wood fasteners to each other, or wood fasteners to the flatcar deck. Also used directly against tracked-vehicle track edges (12mm staples) for lateral restraint when side gates are open.

attachmentTypes.name: KGUUB-1G reusable universal chock (tracked)
attachmentTypes.notes: Set of 4 posts; placed at the chain/track contact point ahead of the second-from-last road wheel, one pair per side.

attachmentTypes.name: Iron spur (demir şpor, Ş-series)
attachmentTypes.notes: Vehicle-type-specific — required spur type is looked up per named 'object' number in Table 13, not chosen freely.

attachmentTypes.name: Iron stop-boot (demir direg başmak, KTP/KT-34/KT-137/KTT)
attachmentTypes.notes: Legacy-vehicle-specific: T-34, IS-4, T-10, T-54, T-55 (early production), PT-76, BTR-50P and their derivatives only.

attachmentTypes.name: S-765 clamp
attachmentTypes.notes: Used together with the MK-765 clamp-tensioner; same vehicle restriction.
